Lemma
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 1. Lemma 3.5\group variation-formulas

If $\partial _t g_{ij}=h_{ij}$, then the Ricci tensor varies by \[ \partial _t R_{jk} = rac12 g^{pq} igl( abla _q abla _j h_{kp} + abla _q abla _k h_{jp} - abla _q abla _p h_{jk} - abla _j abla _k h_{qp} igr). \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0082 \sketch This is the contraction $i=\ell $ of Lemma 1.
